Name: Content Patcher - Fluffykins' Furniture - Paintings Statues and Rugs
Author: Fluffykins202
Description:
SMAPI/Content Patcher version of my original .xnb mod. Thanks to coldazrael for the conversion. His forum post is at: https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/migrating-xnb-mods-to-content-patcher-packs.141577/page-60#post-3304686


Thanks to Jadziyah for the idea to do this. However, since Andy Warhol's art is just painful to look at, I initially made a couple of O'Keeffes and a Rodin and then obviously got kinda carried away. So now a few months later my house looks nothing like Stardew Valley


This mod replaces or retouches almost everything that isn't a table or a
chair. That includes 23 paintings, 20 statues (5 Rodin, 1 Donatello
& 14 Nintendo), 8 Persian rugs (or Afghan, not entirely sure about a
few), and assorted other junk. All of the art is tasteful & public
domain, except maybe for Bob Ross. I tried to avoid being too cliche w/
the choice of art, but after all that's kinda the point of this game,
and thus I kept Starry Night, Persistence of Memory and the Mona Lisa.
By all means feel free to swap out whatever you want if it brings back
bad memories from college or something



How to:

[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Install any content packs you want by unzipping them into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
* there are sort of switch toggles in the config.json file for each furniture packs ( statues, paintings, etc), simply set it true to enable
it or false to disable it
